description: Use to remove the Route A cases; it is also the undo of pd6694_route_a_write. For SSI results use pd6694_ssi_remove. Removes the four PD6694 EP limit-equilibrium load cases with their pressures, load groups and stage activations (the plugin's Remove). Other load cases are kept. Previews unless apply: true.
name: pd6694_route_a_remove
title: Remove PD 6694 Route A cases
